listings.title: Weltevrede Vineyard Estate
listings.alt: Vineyard rows running toward the Banhoek mountains outside Stellenbosch
listings.summary: A registered wine farm on the Banhoek side of Stellenbosch, with 41 hectares under vine, a working cellar and a licensed water use allocation from the Dwars River.
listings.description: Weltevrede sits on the cooler eastern slopes of the Banhoek Valley, where late-ripening reds hold acid longer than they do on the valley floor. Forty-one of the sixty-eight hectares are under vine, planted in blocks between 2004 and 2018, with Cabernet Sauvignon and Shiraz on the upper decomposed granite and Chardonnay on the lower alluvial soils. The cellar handles 320 tonnes a season and carries its own crush, press and 18 stainless tanks. The homestead is a restored 1920s farmhouse, and two cottages currently run as guest accommodation with an existing tourism consent. Water comes from a registered Dwars River abstraction plus three boreholes, and the entire vineyard is under drip. Sold as a going concern with the standing crop, cellar plant and irrigation infrastructure included.

listings.title: Grootvlei Cattle & Grazing Farm
listings.alt: Nguni cattle grazing sweetveld below the Drakensberg escarpment near Bergville
listings.summary: 412 hectares of sweetveld running below the Drakensberg escarpment, split into fourteen camps with a full handling facility and year round water.
listings.description: Grootvlei is a working beef unit on the sweetveld belt outside Bergville, carrying a commercial Nguni and Bonsmara cross herd. The land is divided into fourteen camps with water to every camp from two equipped boreholes and a gravity fed reticulation line off the upper spring. Carrying capacity is measured at 1 large stock unit per 3.2 hectares in a normal season. Infrastructure includes a full handling facility with crush, scale and loading ramp, a 90 tonne feed store, and 46 hectares of planted pasture under dryland. The homestead is a four bedroom face brick house with a separate manager's cottage and four staff units. Rainfall averages 780 mm and the farm has never been destocked for drought in the current owner's fifteen years. Sold with the fixed improvements; livestock negotiable separately.

listings.title: Rietfontein Game Farm
listings.alt: Springbok standing in long grass on Waterberg bushveld
listings.summary: 1 240 hectares of certified game fenced Waterberg bushveld with a six suite lodge, plains game and an existing hunting operation.
listings.description: Rietfontein lies in the Waterberg, an hour north of Vaalwater on gravel, and is fully enclosed by 2.4 metre certified game fence. The property runs a plains game population including kudu, impala, waterbuck, zebra, blue wildebeest and giraffe, with a counted estimate of roughly 640 animals at the last aerial census. Income currently comes from a six suite thatched lodge with its own boma, a separate four bed hunting camp and a walk in cold room with a carcass rail. Twelve boreholes feed a network of drinking troughs and three pans hold water through most of the dry season. The bush is mixed broadleaf and thorn on sandy soil, with a rocky ridge running the northern boundary that gives the lodge its view. Sold as a going concern with the game, lodge contents and vehicles included.

Game Farm.Wildlife species: Kudu, impala, waterbuck, zebra, blue wildebeest, giraffe, warthog

Buildings & Infrastructure.Storage facilities: Walk in cold room with carcass rail

Power & Utilities.Solar power: Yes, 36 kWp plus solar borehole pumps

Legal Information.Servitudes: Right of way to neighbouring farm registered

listings.title: Sonop Citrus & Irrigation Farm
listings.alt: Citrus orchard rows with the Drakensberg foothills behind, near Hoedspruit
listings.summary: 186 hectares under a registered Blyde River scheme allocation, 112 hectares of bearing citrus, packhouse and cold chain on site.
listings.description: Sonop is an established citrus unit on the Hoedspruit flats with a registered allocation off the Blyde River irrigation scheme, the single most valuable asset on the property. One hundred and twelve hectares carry bearing Valencia, Midknight and soft citrus, planted between 2011 and 2020, all under drip with a fertigation shed and a scheduling system already in place. The farm packs its own fruit through a 12 tonne per hour line with two cold rooms and a dispatch bay rated for export loading. Three centre pivots cover a further 22 hectares currently under maize and vegetables in rotation. Staff housing accommodates 34 permanent workers and there is a separate seasonal compound. Power is Eskom backed by a 300 kWp solar plant that carries the packhouse through daytime load shedding. Sold as a going concern.

Crop Farming.Current crops: Valencia, Midknight, soft citrus, maize rotation
Crop Farming.Yield history: 48 to 62 tonnes per hectare on mature blocks

listings.title: Rietkuil Grain & Sunflower Farm
listings.alt: Striped grain lands running to the horizon with a farmstead among trees, Free State
listings.summary: 780 hectares of Free State grain land outside Bothaville, 640 hectares arable, with 3 400 tonnes of silo capacity on the farm and a full implement fleet included.
listings.description: Rietkuil lies on the red sandy loam belt west of Bothaville, the district that turns over more maize than any other in the country. Six hundred and forty of the seven hundred and eighty hectares are arable and have been in a maize, sunflower and soya rotation for the last twelve seasons, with yield records kept per camp. The farm carries its own storage: four silos rated at 3 400 tonnes combined, a grading floor and a weighbridge, which means the owner sells on his own timing rather than the co-operative's. Water is domestic and stock only, from three boreholes, as the lands are dryland. Improvements include a four bedroom homestead, two staff houses, a large implement shed and a workshop. The full implement fleet, including two tractors, a planter, a boom sprayer and the combine harvester, is included in the price.

Crop Farming.Yield history: 4.8 to 6.4 t/ha maize, 12 seasons on record

Equipment Included.Implements included: Planter, boom sprayer, disc harrow, ripper

listings.title: Kareepoort Sheep & Karoo Grazing
listings.alt: Open Karoo veld running to a low ridge under a wide sky
listings.summary: 3 400 hectares of Upper Karoo grazing carrying a Dorper flock, twenty two camps, water to every camp and a shearing shed on the farm.
listings.description: Kareepoort is a classic Upper Karoo sheep unit an hour from Victoria West on gravel. The veld is sweet Karoo bossieveld on shale, measured at one small stock unit per 4.6 hectares in a normal season, which puts the farm at roughly 740 sheep before any supplementary feeding. It is divided into twenty two camps, each with a drinking trough fed from six windmills and two solar boreholes through 14 kilometres of piping. The handling infrastructure is complete and in use: a four stand shearing shed with a wool press, sorting pens, a dip and a loading ramp. The homestead is an old Karoo farmhouse with pressed ceilings, restored in 2018, with a separate cottage that has been let for stargazing weekends. Rainfall averages 280 mm and the farm has permanent stock water in every camp, which is the reason it holds through dry years.

Livestock.Sheep facilities: Yes, 4 stand shearing shed and wool press

Security.Boundary fencing: Yes, jackal proof on 60 per cent

Legal Information.Servitudes: Right of way to neighbouring farm

listings.title: Melkhout Dairy Farm
listings.alt: Holstein dairy cow on kikuyu pasture with green hills behind, Eastern Cape
listings.summary: A pasture based dairy on the Tsitsikamma coast milking 420 cows through a 40 point rotary, with 196 hectares under irrigated kikuyu and ryegrass.
listings.description: Melkhout sits in the Humansdorp dairy belt, where the rainfall and the mild coast make pasture based milk production work without a feedlot. The herd is 420 Holstein and Jersey cross cows in milk, running on 196 hectares of irrigated kikuyu over-sown with ryegrass, split into 48 grazing paddocks on a rotational system. Milking is through a 40 point rotary parlour installed in 2019, with plate cooling, a 12 000 litre bulk tank and automatic cup removers. Effluent goes to a two pond system and back onto the pasture. Water is a registered abstraction off the Kromme River plus four boreholes, feeding eight travelling irrigators. Rainfall averages 720 mm spread through the year. The property includes a main homestead, a manager's house and eleven staff units. Sold as a going concern with the herd, the parlour plant and the irrigation infrastructure included.

Livestock.Carrying capacity: 2.1 cows per ha on irrigated pasture

Buildings & Infrastructure.Storage facilities: Milk room, 12 000 L bulk tank, feed store

Equipment Included.Implements included: Mixer wagon, mower, fertiliser spreader, slurry tanker

listings.title: Nooitgedacht Macadamia Estate
listings.alt: Misty subtropical valley above White River in the Mpumalanga lowveld
listings.summary: 98 hectares of bearing macadamia and 22 of avocado above White River, with a cracking and drying plant on site and a registered Crocodile River allocation.
listings.description: Nooitgedacht sits on the escarpment side of White River, high enough to escape the worst of the lowveld heat and low enough to carry macadamia comfortably. Ninety eight hectares are under bearing macadamia, mostly Beaumont and 816 planted between 2009 and 2019, with a further twenty two hectares of Hass and Fuerte avocado. Nut in shell goes through the farm's own dehusking, drying and cracking plant, which is licensed and has spare capacity that has been contract processed for two neighbours. Water is a registered allocation off the Crocodile River scheme plus five boreholes, and every orchard is under drip with fertigation. The property carries a homestead with a view down the valley, three cottages currently run as guest units, and staff housing for eighteen. Sold as a going concern with the standing crop, the plant and the vehicles included.

Crop Farming.Yield history: 3.1 to 3.8 t/ha nut in shell on mature blocks

Buildings & Infrastructure.Storage facilities: Nut store, chemical store, cold room

listings.title: Klipheuwel Olive Smallholding
listings.alt: Whitewashed gabled farmhouse on green lawn under a wide sky
listings.summary: 21 hectares in the Riebeek Valley with 9 hectares of established olives, a restored three bedroom homestead and a two bedroom cottage already letting.
listings.description: Klipheuwel is the size most buyers actually want when they say they are looking for a farm: small enough to run yourself, large enough to earn something. Nine of the twenty one hectares carry established Mission and Frantoio olives planted in 2011, producing between eleven and fourteen tonnes a season, currently pressed under contract at a neighbouring mill. The homestead is a restored three bedroom werf house with a stoep facing Kasteelberg, and a separate two bedroom cottage has been letting on short stays for four years with its own entrance. Water is two boreholes and a registered stream diversion, feeding drip through the whole grove and a 400 square metre vegetable garden. The balance of the land is grazing for a few head, and the zoning is agricultural with an existing consent for the guest cottage.
